verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents per-user API Access Tokens that grant access to resources such as CKS clusters and VPCs, with guidance on keeping credentials secure. It also offers group-based access control in AI Object Storage bucket policies and token exchange for temporary storage credentials. On the spend side there are quotas and billing usage breakdowns, but nothing ties spend limits to individual users or keys. Missing for 10: documented team or organization member management with assignable roles, explicit scoping of API tokens to specific permissions or resources, per-team or per-key spend controls, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
